About me / Introduction

Hi, I'm
Michele.

I'm a full-stack web developer focused on building responsive, user-friendly interfaces with React, TypeScript, and Next.js. Over the past year and a half, I've co-founded a small web agency and delivered projects for clients, from interactive experiences and e-commerce storefronts to API integrations and backend services. I enjoy breaking down complex requirements into clear interfaces, reusable components, and practical solutions. Before moving into software engineering, I graduated from the University of Turin and worked in football data analysis, which helped shape my analytical approach to problem-solving. Below is a selection of my work.

PRINTFORGE

01 / 04
Learning project / Next.js & component-driven UI

PrintForge.

A full-stack learning project from Scrimba's Next.js course, implemented with React, TypeScript, and the Next.js App Router. I practiced building reusable, typed UI components and shared layouts, separating Server and Client Components, and implementing server-side data fetching with Cloudflare D1 (SQLite). The catalog supports dynamic routes, URL-based search, sorting and pagination, with loading, empty and not-found states. Deployed to Cloudflare Workers using OpenNext.

FlyOn360.

An interactive virtual tour platform for exploring cultural heritage sites across Basilicata through 360° panoramas, interactive hotspots, maps, and immersive media. I developed this project for a client using React and TypeScript, creating an immersive experience with Three.js scenes, Leaflet maps, bilingual content, and WebXR support. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages, with multimedia assets hosted on Cloudflare R2.

04 / 04
Client project / E-commerce & system integration

Didalibri.

I built a Shopify e-commerce store for a stationery and bookstore client, customizing the storefront with CSS. The key technical challenge was integrating Shopify with the client’s legacy management system, which used a Visual FoxPro database stored in DBF files. To bridge the incompatibility, I developed a lightweight Python integration service (with assistance from ChatGPT) that reads and processes the legacy records, cleans and normalizes product data, and transforms it into a format compatible with Shopify. The service uses Shopify’s Admin GraphQL API to synchronize the book and stationery product catalog with the online store.
